title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts, docs site updates
author: Maya Thompson
description: Adds a curated set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts plus accompanying docs site updates and examples. Motivation: provide repeatable starter templates for customers building retrieval-augmented agents with tool integrations (search, SQL, calendar). This PR includes: 1) template agents in redwood-examples/agents/{faq,assistant-with-search,calendar-agent} with config and sample prompts; 2) tool adapters and example tool stubs for search/SQL/calendar; 3) quickstart guides in docssite/content/quickstarts/agents explaining setup, deployment modes, and troubleshooting; 4) example tests and a small e2e harness used in CI. Related: ENG-3421 (RAG onboarding) and SUP-1284 (customer request for calendar tool example).
commits: feat: add faq rag agent template and prompt engineering notes
feat: add tool adapters (search, sql, calendar) and example stubs
docs: quickstart pages and docsite navigation entries for agents
test: add e2e example harness and CI workflow for agent quickstarts
review_comments: Jordan Kim: Nice set of examples, can we add a short note on cost implications of long context windows? Author reply: added a short cost note to getting-started.md and linked to Optimize guide.
Samir Desai: For the calendar adapter, please redact the example API key and add a KMS note. Author reply: switched sample to use env var and added KMS integration paragraph.
Elena Ruiz: Docs site nav entry needs a category; suggest 'Quickstarts / Agents' Author reply: moved pages under docssite quickstarts and updated sidebar config.
QA Bot: e2e test failed on first run due to flaky network call; Author reply: added retry/backoff and mock harness; CI rerun passed.
ci_checks: E2E agent quickstart workflow: pass (after fix)
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts for FAQ, search-enabled assistant, and calendar integrations; updated docs site with quickstarts and examples; added CI e2e harness for agent quickstarts.
notes: Kept examples minimal and platform-agnostic; customers can plug in hosted vs dedicated deployment configurations. Follow-up tasks: add example for private deployment (ENG-3562) and add telemetry examples for Console.
squash_message: Add RAG agent templates, tool adapters, and docs quickstarts\n\nThis brings a small suite of starter agents and docs to help customers get started with retrieval-augmented agents and tool-calling integrations. Includes e2e test harness and CI workflow.
